Claim.description: An attributed assertion: related statements that one or more identified claimants present together about a subject, at a stated time. A Claim is asserted by definition, so it is self-attested by its claimants and is valid without any third-party attestation; later reviews are separate resources that point to it. An unasserted authoring candidate, such as an extraction draft without a claimant, is not a Claim. Every version is immutable: a correction is a new Claim that states wasRevisionOf.

assertedAt.description: When the claimants made this assertion. For an assertion they made in a source document, such as a project plan, and that was transcribed later, it is when they made it there, not when it was extracted, transcribed or submitted. It is never the time of an observation, or the time the Claim record was generated, submitted, published or ingested. The same content asserted at a different time is a different Claim. Written in UTC with whole seconds, in the XSD canonical form, for example 2026-05-02T07:30:00Z. A local offset is not accepted.

description.description: The assertion as the claimant states it in natural language. This is asserted content, not a presentational summary: changing it changes the Claim.

hasClaimType.description: Subject-matter classification of what is asserted, drawn from the ClaimType taxonomy. It classifies content only: it does not declare which schema or schema version the document conforms to, and it does not by itself select a verification pathway.

hasClaimant.description: The agent or agents that take responsibility for making this assertion: an individual, organization or community. Each listed claimant takes responsibility for the whole assertion. A collective that asserts as one body is a single claimant of type COMMUNITY or ORGANIZATION; listing it does not make its members co-claimants. A service that extracted, generated or submitted the RDF is not a claimant unless it asserts the content itself. Specializes prov:wasAttributedTo, so under PROV each claimant is an agent associated with the activity that generated the Claim, which is the act of asserting. Unordered set.

hasEvidence.description: Sources the claimant presents as evidence for the assertion, each an Evidence node identified by the IRI of the exact version cited. Whether a source actually supports the assertion is judged separately, by attestations. Specializes dcterms:references. Unordered set.

hasSubject.description: What the claim is about, as a ClaimSubject node identified by its IRI: a place, plot, project, organization, community, indicator, dataset or another claim. Claims about the same subject share its IRI and can be joined. Specialized claim schemas narrow the range to a subclass of ClaimSubject. Not the claimant, and not necessarily the feature of interest of an observation inside the claim.

url.description: Link to a page with more information about the claim. A pointer for readers, not evidence; cite evidence with hasEvidence.

wasRevisionOf.description: Identifier of the exact, immutable earlier Claim version that this Claim revises, typically its ClaimIRI. It never names a logical claim or version family. In PROV a revision implies that both versions are aspects of the same thing (alternateOf), so use it only for a revised version of the same assertion; a separate, later assertion, such as a follow-up observation, is a new Claim and is not a revision. The earlier version is unchanged, its attestations do not carry over, and selecting a current version happens outside the Claim.
